definitions.meaning: A wound-fine or compensation for a wound

quotations.old_english: Béte dolgbóte [dolhbóte MS. H.] let him make compensation for the wound

source_text: dolh-bót, dolg-bót, e; f. [bót compensation] A wound-fine or compensation for a wound; vuln&e-short;ris compens&a-long;tio :-- Béte dolgbóte [dolhbóte MS. H.] let him make compensation for the wound, L. Alf. pol. 23; Th. i. 78, 7.
